sec.actionDesc: Every tone with its action: Undo, Open, Review, Try again (an error always says how to fix it) and Check again (when a change may have gone through, the person can check whether it did).
sec.plainDesc: Only for a result with no place on screen. Errors and unknown outcomes always carry an action in the product; they are shown bare here only to compare the tones.
sec.longDesc: Long text wraps inside the toast; the action and the close button keep their size.
sec.liveDesc: Fires a real toast. Ok, info and warning close after 4 seconds; error and unknown stay until closed.
